guide: Open Start here, type your organization name and read the settings: your retention target, the cost to raise one dollar, your estimates for lapsed donors who return and your stage estimates for the pipeline.
Keep Donors and Giving by Donor and Year up to date: one row per donor with the total given in each of the last four years, from your gift log.

Work the Lapsed List from rank 1: Call, Write or Let go. Set a caller and a contact date for each.
Use Upgrade Ask List and Downgrade Watch to plan asks and calls, and First-Time Donors with Second-Gift Conversion to follow up first gifts.
Keep Prospects current with stage, ask, next step and its date; Next Steps Due and Pipeline by Stage fill in.
Type the cost of every appeal in Appeal Costs, then read Appeal Results and Source Results for Keep, Fix or Stop.
Check Top Donors and Concentration Scenarios before you set the budget.

To replace the demo data, clear the yellow cells of each sheet, paste your own donors, gifts and prospects and check the Start here settings.

listing.title: Nonprofit Donor Retention and Major Gifts Excel Template: Lapsed Donors, Upgrade Asks, Appeal Results, Gift Pipeline
listing.headline: See who stays, who lapsed and who to ask next
listing.description:
Run the donor growth side of a small nonprofit in one Excel workbook. Built for an executive director, a development manager or a founder with volunteers who needs to know which donors stay, which have lapsed and who to ask next. Giving by Donor and Year shows every donor as retained, new, recaptured or lapsed. Retention Detail gives retention, new-donor retention and repeat-donor retention by donor group against your own last year. Lapsed List ranks donors to Call, Write or Let go, Upgrade Ask List suggests an ask from each regular donor's own average gift, and Downgrade Watch shows donors whose giving fell.

First-Time Donors and Second-Gift Conversion show who gave a second time by appeal. Prospects holds the major-gift pipeline with stages, weighted value (your own estimate) and next steps, and Next Steps Due ranks what is overdue. Appeal Costs, Appeal Results and Source Results give the cost to raise one dollar by appeal and channel with Keep, Fix or Stop. Top Donors and Concentration Scenarios show what losing a large donor does to your months of reserve.

18 tools answer weekly questions with a verdict, a what-if grid and your own history. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to donors, prospects, staff and the board. The dashboard shows 30 live figures, 22 charts and 6 gauges.

This is part two of an eight-part Nonprofit Organization suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no per-contact fee, with a demo copy of sample data. Donors appear as a name, contact preference, amounts and dates only. It helps you keep track of your own numbers and does not promise any gift, grant or result. It is not a mass-email tool, a payment service, or accounting or legal advice; ask your accountant what your own rules need.
